spec.name: A
spec.query: ( sum by (pod, namespace, container, label_resource_name) ( container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!="POD",container!="",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{label_resource_type="service",label_resource_name!~"ai-python-app|ai-python-worker|audit-service-v2|bkout-integration-auth-backend|bkout-one-workflow-backend|integration-service|workflow-queue-workers",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) / sum by (pod, namespace, container, label_resource_name) ( kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{label_resource_type="service",label_resource_name!~"ai-python-app|ai-python-worker|audit-service-v2|bkout-integration-auth-backend|bkout-one-workflow-backend|integration-service|workflow-queue-workers",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) )

annotations.resolution: Memory near limit. kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} top pods; watch for OOM; review limit/leak; scale out or raise the limit.
annotations.summary: {{ $labels.label_resource_name }} pod {{ $labels.pod }} memory at {{ printf "%.2f" $value }} of limit
